title: The Girl Who Drank the Moon
author: Kelly Barnhill
summary: A kind witch accidentally feeds moonlight to a baby left in the forest, filling her with magic. The child grows up in an unusual household, while the town that gave her up believes that a witch demands a yearly sacrifice.
readIf: you like warm, imaginative fantasy for all ages, with a fairy-tale shape and a big heart.
skipIf: you want fast action or a darker fantasy, because this one is slow, gentle and strongly focused on love.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny fantasy about an unusual household and a young woman learning about magic.
A darker, more atmospheric fairy-tale with a similar feeling of old magic.
Another lyrical, bittersweet fairy tale about belonging and wonder.
